Canvas Quality Confirmation

Drop a course export in and get the confirmation form answered from the evidence in it. Every answer stays editable, and each one shows exactly what it was based on.

Step 1 — Add the export

In Canvas: Settings → Export Course Content → Course → Create Export, then download the .imscc file.

Drop the .imscc file here or press Enter to browse. Nothing is uploaded, it all happens in this browser tab.
Standards this checks against

These are the reference values the checks compare each course to. Change them here if the standard moves, then press Re-run checks.

Step 3 — Take it to the form

Microsoft Forms cannot be pre-filled from a link, so the answers copy across as text. The report keeps the evidence with the answers for your records.

The report is the Quality Confirmation merge template with all 38 answers written in, so there is no mail merge step. Copy row puts one tab separated line on the clipboard, in the same 43 column order as the master spreadsheet. Select the first empty cell in column A and paste, and it will spread across the row. The evidence record is the working copy, holding what each answer was based on and what was signed off.

Privacy: a course export holds course content only, with no student names, submissions or grades in it. This tool runs entirely in your browser and needs no internet connection. The file is never sent anywhere.
